DARV.talk.YUNO_MOD_CHARACTER_YUNO_CHARAC: There are so many things here, so many shiny stones.
Haha! Seems even gems can't light up your eyes! Come pick one!
You don't seem to want anything... Then look around, I'm not in a hurry anyway.
I have millions of gems here, but none of them seems able to make you stop...

Fine, have it your way. Let me just pick one.
[i][font_size=22]Yuno casually picks up an unremarkable stone.[/font_size][/i]
Hahaha! You took the best one I have!
NEOW.talk.YUNO_MOD_CHARACTER_YUNO_CHARAC:
[sine]...You've come again... 
...Knowing full well... that everything... ..will repeat.....[/sine]
If you want to give me something... never mind... you can't give me what I want.

[sine]...Go on... 
..Be it the tower's top... or its bottom... ..Either way... we'll meet again.....[/sine]
NONUPEIPE.talk.YUNO_MOD_CHARACTER_YUNO_C: A gorgeous room. How dazzling you are. I have nothing... but I need nothing...
Oh my, even if you have nothing, a little light from me will make you shine.
That temperament of wanting nothing is rather interesting. Let me dress you up a little.
Even if you think you want nothing, you should at least make yourself look presentable.

You surely have none... but as you like.
[i][font_size=22]Yuno stands in place, like a hollow statue that forgot to be painted.[/font_size][/i]
Tsk, what an unromantic girl. Take it - this is the last bit of warmth I have left.
OROBAS.talk.YUNO_MOD_CHARACTER_YUNO_CHAR: You jump so high. Is there someone you want to dance for?
Here!! I'm the only one here! Fluffy!
What do you want? I have lots of good stuff here!!
From another world? Good, good! What's there?
(Told a few things about her original world.)
So many, many interesting things! The little one knows a lot! Good! Good!! These are my gifts for you!
PAEL.talk.YUNO_MOD_CHARACTER_YUNO_CHARAC: Your snoring is so steady. Like the last regular thing left in this world.
[thinky_dots]Your heart is quieter than mine... Take it, this is a gift meant for the quiet ones...[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]Those who strive for nothing often go the farthest... Or are you not planning to go at all?[/thinky_dots]
[thinky_dots]My flesh won't rush you... it will only sit with you while you space out...[/thinky_dots]

...Pain, sleep, or waking. They're all about the same, really.
[i][font_size=22]Yuno's tone is very light, as if speaking of something that has nothing to do with her.[/font_size][/i]
[thinky_dots]Take it... let you keep sitting here... watching the tides rise and fall, without getting your feet wet...[/thinky_dots]
TANX.talk.YUNO_MOD_CHARACTER_YUNO_CHARAC: You want to fight. I refuse.
[b]Your blood is still warm! Since you're alive, swing it once and show me![/b]

If you want to fight, then fight.
[i][font_size=22]Yuno lets the sword tip droop toward the ground, as if casually setting a battle aside.[/font_size][/i]
[b]Take it. This sword is your trophy. You must move forward! Don't look back![/b]
TEZCATARA.talk.YUNO_MOD_CHARACTER_YUNO_C: The fire is warm. But I have nothing that needs warming.
You can still warm your hands without anything. Come in, let me [jitter][b]warm[/b][/jitter] you up out of boredom.
You're so hollow - did you pack up and mail away even your [jitter][b]emotions[/b][/jitter]?
Try this [jitter][b]snack[/b][/jitter]. The kind you don't need to hurry to finish.

...Flavor is about the same whether you have it or not. But since you offered it.
[i][font_size=22]Yuno takes it and takes just a single bite.[/font_size][/i]
What an interesting child. Then hold it - wait for it to slowly [jitter][b]go cold[/b][/jitter].
VAKUU.talk.YUNO_MOD_CHARACTER_YUNO_CHARA: Even demons make deals. My soul... take it if you want it.
A barely-used [sine]soul[/sine] actually sells for the highest price...
You don't even have the interest to haggle? That [sine]empty[/sine] attitude - how fascinating.
If the contract said only one word - [sine]"nothing"[/sine] - would you sign it?

"Nothing" is a good word. Heavier than my own name. I'll sign.
[i][font_size=22]Her signature is light as a pen without ink, leaving an invisible scratch on the paper.[/font_size][/i]
Interesting! I've never seen anyone sign [sine]nothingness[/sine] so firmly. Take it - this is the price of your blankness.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.YUNO_MOD_CHARACTER_YU: You don't belong here? Why have you come to see me?
Home? Impossible. I have no reason to tell you.
I must make you spit it out.
Still not giving up? What I do is only to maintain order.
The tower remembers you. You've come many times; how tenacious. How many more times will you go on?
